title: Edit Customer works on a phone with the tier fields stacked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Use a phone, or a browser window narrower than 768 pixels.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Tap Work Order Tier.
  4. Tap tier A.
  5. Tap Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer opens with the fields stacked one under another.
  • Work Order Tier and Part Sales Tier sit under Default Shop Supplies, before Notes.

Step 3:

  • The picker lists the active tiers by number, tier A among them.

Step 4:

  • Work Order Tier reads tier A.

Step 5:

  • The customer saves; the card shows tier A for work orders.
